value.rationale: The two counts are natural opposite-color isolation statistics in fixed-weight runs tests. Conditioning on total runs, the standard randomness-test summary, reverses a strictly positive unconditional covariance into nonpositive covariance in every stratum; a universal negative three-run formula and a complete sharp odd/even classification identify the mechanism. This is a structural finite-sample dependence result, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
